en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5761 - Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Blessed and Exalted, established brotherhood between souls in the realm of shadows (Al-aẓillah) two thousand years before creating bodies.
So, when our Qaʾim (Imam Muhammad ibn Hassan Al-Mahdi (as)) from the Ahl Al-Bayt (as) rises, He (as) will give inheritance to the brother with whom brotherhood was established in the realm of shadows and will not give inheritance to the brother through birth."
